name: HOPE LEFT ME
source:
You wake up in a mysterious place, alone and freezing to death, the only person around seems to be a weird girl with a long sleeve soviet jersey.

[From [url=https://astrophysicsdev.itch.io/hope-left-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个神秘的地方醒来，孤身一人，冻死了，周围唯一的人似乎是一个穿着长袖苏联球衣的奇怪女孩。

[来自[url=https://astrophysicsdev.itch.io/hope-left-me]itch.io[/url]]
